note: Verse text only; Psalms are numbered as in the Gitsawe (Ethiopian/Septuagint).

PSA 10:3-m: አንተ የሠራኸውን እነሆ እነርሱ አፍርሰዋልና፤ ጻድቅ ግን ምን አደረገ?
If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
እግዚአብሔር በተቀደሰው መቅደሱ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር፥ ዙፋኑ በሰማይ ነው፤ ዓይኖቹ ወደ ድሃ ይመለከታሉ፥ ቅንድቦቹም የሰው ልጆችን ይመረምራሉ።
Yahweh is in his holy temple. Yahweh is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
JHN 12:42-EOC: ከዚህም ጋር ከአለቆች ደግሞ ብዙዎች በእርሱ አመኑ፤ ነገር ግን ከምኵራብ እንዳያስወጡአቸው በፈሪሳውያን ምክንያት አልመሰከሩለትም፤
Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,
ከእግዚአብሔር ክብር ይልቅ የሰውን ክብር ወደዋልና።
for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.
ኢየሱስም ጮኸ፥ እንዲህም አለ። በእኔ የሚያምን በላከኝ ማመኑ ነው እንጂ በእኔ አይደለም፤
Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
He who sees me sees him who sent me.
በእኔ የሚያምን ሁሉ በጨለማ እንዳይኖር እኔ ብርሃን ሆኜ ወደ ዓለም መጥቻለሁ።
I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
ዓለምን ላድን እንጂ በዓለም ልፈርድ አልመጣሁምና ቃሌን ሰምቶ የማይጠብቀው ቢኖር የምፈርድበት እኔ አይደለሁም።
If anyone listens to my sayings, and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
የሚጥለኝ ቃሌንም የማይቀበለው እርሱ የሚፈርድበት አለው፤ እኔ የተናገርሁት ቃል እርሱ በመጨረሻው ቀን ይፈርድበታል።
He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke, the same will judge him in the last day.
እኔ ከራሴ አልተናገርሁምና፤ ነገር ግን የላከኝ አብ እርሱ የምለውን የምናገረውንም ትእዛዝ ሰጠኝ።
For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
ትእዛዙም የዘላለም ሕይወት እንደ ሆነች አውቃለሁ። ስለዚህ እኔ የምናገረውን አብ እንደ ነገረኝ እንዲሁ እናገራለሁ።
I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
HEB 11:21-32: ያዕቆብ ሲሞት በእምነት የዮሴፍን ልጆች እያንዳንዳቸው ባረካቸው፥ በዘንጉም ጫፍ ተጠግቶ ሰገደ።
By faith, Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
ዮሴፍ ወደ ሞት ቀርቦ ሳለ በእምነት ስለ እስራኤል ልጆች መውጣት አስታወሰ፥ ስለ አጥንቱም አዘዛቸው።
By faith, Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel; and gave instructions concerning his bones.
ሙሴ ከተወለደ በኋላ ወላጆቹ ያማረ ሕፃን መሆኑን አይተው በእምነት ሦስት ወር ሸሸጉት የንጉሥንም አዋጅ አልፈሩም።
By faith, Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
ሙሴ ካደገ በኋላ የፈርዖን የልጅ ልጅ እንዳይባል በእምነት እምቢ አለ፤
By faith, Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
ከግብፅም ብዙ ገንዘብ ይልቅ ስለ ክርስቶስ መነቀፍ እጅግ የሚበልጥ ባለ ጠግነት እንዲሆን አስቦአልና ለጊዜው በኃጢአት ከሚገኝ ደስታ ይልቅ ከእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ጋር መከራ መቀበልን መረጠ፤ ብድራቱን ትኵር ብሎ ተመልክቶአልና።
choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time;
accounting the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
የንጉሡን ቍጣ ሳይፈራ የግብፅን አገር የተወ በእምነት ነበር፤ የማይታየውን እንደሚያየው አድርጎ ጸንቶአልና።
By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
አጥፊው የበኵሮችን ልጆች እንዳይነካ ፋሲካንና ደምን መርጨትን በእምነት አደረገ።
By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
በደረቅ ምድር እንደሚያልፉ በኤርትራ ባሕር በእምነት ተሻገሩ፥ የግብፅ ሰዎች ግን ሲሞክሩ ተዋጡ።
By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
የኢያሪኮ ቅጥር ሰባት ቀን ከዞሩበት በኋላ በእምነት ወደቀ።
By faith, the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been encircled for seven days.
ጋለሞታይቱ ረዓብ ሰላዮችን በሰላም ስለ ተቀበለቻቸው ከማይታዘዙ ጋር በእምነት አልጠፋችም።
By faith, Rahab the prostitute, didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
እንግዲህ ምን እላለሁ? ስለ ጌዴዎንና ስለ ባርቅ ስለ ሶምሶንም ስለ ዮፍታሔም ስለ ዳዊትና ስለ ሳሙኤልም ስለ ነቢያትም እንዳልተርክ ጊዜ ያጥርብኛልና።
What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets;
1PE 4:12-EOC: ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ በእናንተ መካከል እንደ እሳት ሊፈትናችሁ ስለሚሆነው መከራ ድንቅ ነገር እንደ መጣባችሁ አትደነቁ፤
Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you, to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.
ነገር ግን ክብሩ ሲገለጥ ደግሞ ሐሤት እያደረጋችሁ ደስ እንዲላችሁ፥ በክርስቶስ መከራ በምትካፈሉበት ልክ ደስ ይበላችሁ።
But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice; that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ብትነቀፉ የክብር መንፈስ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በእናንተ ላይ ያርፋልና ብፁዓን ናችሁ።
If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed; because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.
ከእናንተ ማንም ነፍሰ ገዳይ ወይም ሌባ ወይም ክፉ አድራጊ እንደሚሆን ወይም በሌሎች ጒዳይ እንደሚገባ ሆኖ መከራን አይቀበል፤
For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
ክርስቲያን እንደሚሆን ግን መከራን ቢቀበል ስለዚህ ስም እግዚአብሔርን ያመስግን እንጂ አይፈር።
But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.
ፍርድ ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት ተነሥቶ የሚጀመርበት ጊዜ ደርሶአልና፤ አስቀድሞም በእኛ የሚጀመር ከሆነ ለእግዚአብሔር ወንጌል የማይታዘዙ መጨረሻቸው ምን ይሆን?
For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?
ጻድቅም በጭንቅ የሚድን ከሆነ ዓመፀኛውና ኃጢአተኛው ወዴት ይታይ ዘንድ አለው?
“If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
ስለዚህ ደግሞ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ መከራን የሚቀበሉ፥ መልካምን እያደረጉ ነፍሳቸውን ለታመነ ፈጣሪ አደራ ይስጡ።
Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
ACT 7:9-23: የአባቶችም አለቆች በዮሴፍ ቀንተው ወደ ግብፅ ሸጡት፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ፥
“The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him,
ከመከራውም ሁሉ አወጣው፥ በግብፅ ንጉሥ በፈርዖንም ፊት ሞገስንና ጥበብን ሰጠው፥ በግብፅና በቤቱ ሁሉ ላይም ቢትወደድ አድርጎ ሾመው።
and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
በግብፅና በከነዓንም አገር ሁሉ ራብና ብዙ ጭንቅ መጣ፥ አባቶቻችንም ምግብን አላገኙም።
Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.
ያዕቆብም በግብፅ እህል መኖሩን በሰማ ጊዜ በመጀመሪያ አባቶቻችንን ሰደዳቸው፤
But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.
በሁለተኛውም ዮሴፍ ለወንድሞቹ ታወቀ፥ የዮሴፍም ትውልድ በፈርዖን ዘንድ ተገለጠ።
On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s race was revealed to Pharaoh.
ዮሴፍም አባቱን ያዕቆብንና ሰባ አምስት ነፍስ የነበረውን ቤተ ዘመድ ሁሉ ልኮ አስጠራ።
Joseph sent, and summoned Jacob, his father, and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
ያዕቆብም ወደ ግብፅ ወረደ እርሱም ሞተ አባቶቻችንም፤
Jacob went down into Egypt, and he died, himself and our fathers,
ወደ ሴኬምም አፍልሰው አብርሃም ከሴኬም አባት ከኤሞር ልጆች በብር በገዛው መቃብር ቀበሩአቸው።
and they were brought back to Shechem, and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
እግዚአብሔርም ለአብርሃም የማለለት የተስፋው ዘመን ሲቀርብ፥ ዮሴፍን የማያውቀው ሌላ ንጉሥ በግብፅ ላይ እስኪነሣ ድረስ፥ ሕዝቡ እየተጨመሩ በግብፅ በዙ።
“But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
until there arose a different king, who didn’t know Joseph.
እርሱም ወገናችንን ተተንኵሎ ሕፃናትን በሕይወት እንዳይጠብቁ ወደ ውጭ ይጥሉ ዘንድ አድርጎ አባቶቻችንን አስጨነቀ።
The same took advantage of our race, and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to throw out their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.

Let your beauty be not just the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on fine clothing;

but in the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God very precious.
እንዲህ በቀድሞ ዘመን በእግዚአብሔር ተስፋ ያደረጉት ቅዱሳት ሴቶች ደግሞ ለባሎቻቸው ሲገዙ ተሸልመው ነበርና፤
For this is how the holy women before, who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:
እንዲሁም ሣራ ለአብርሃም። ጌታ ብላ እየጠራችው ታዘዘችለት፤ እናንተም ከሚያስደነግጥ ነገር አንዳች እንኳ ሳትፈሩ መልካም ብታደርጉ ልጆችዋ ናችሁ።
as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are, if you do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.
እንዲሁም፥ እናንተ ባሎች ሆይ፥ ደካማ ፍጥረት ስለ ሆኑ ከሚስቶቻችሁ ጋር በማስተዋል አብራችሁ ኑሩ፤ ጸሎታችሁ እንዳይከለከል አብረው ደግሞ የሕይወትን ጸጋ እንደሚወርሱ አድርጋችሁ አክብሩአቸው።

You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman, as to the weaker vessel, as being also joint heirs of the grace of life; that your prayers may not be hindered.
ACT 20:17-25: ከሚሊጢንም ወደ ኤፌሶን ልኮ የቤተክርስቲያንን ሽማግሌዎች አስጠራቸው፤
From Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called to himself the elders of the assembly.
ወደ እርሱም በመጡ ጊዜ እንዲህ አላቸው። ወደ እስያ ከገባሁበት ከመጀመሪያ ቀን ጀምሮ፥ በትሕትና ሁሉና በእንባ ከአይሁድም ሴራ በደረሰብኝ ፈተና ለጌታ እየተገዛሁ ዘመኑን ሁሉ ከእናንተ ጋር እንዴት እንደ ኖርሁ እናንተው ታውቃላችሁ፤
When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,
serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;
ወደ እግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ንስሐንና በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ማመንን ለአይሁድና ለግሪክ ሰዎች እየመሰከርሁ በጉባኤም በየቤታችሁም አወራሁላችሁና አስተማርኋችሁ እንጂ፥ ከሚጠቅማችሁ ነገር አንዳች ስንኳ አላስቀረሁባችሁም።
how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,
testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus.
አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እኔ በመንፈስ ታስሬ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እሄዳለሁ፥ በዚያም የሚያገኘኝ ምን እንደ ሆነ አላውቅም፤

ነገር ግን ሩጫዬንና ከጌታ ከኢየሱስ የተቀበልሁትን አገልግሎት እርሱም የእግዚአብሔርን ጸጋ ወንጌልን መመስከር እፈጽም ዘንድ ነፍሴን በእኔ ዘንድ እንደማትከብር እንደ ከንቱ ነገር እቆጥራለሁ።

He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
ሴቲቱንም። እምነትሽ አድኖሻል፤ በሰላም ሂጂ አላት።

“I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

“Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
እላችሁማለሁ፥ በሰው ፊት የሚመሰክርልኝ ሁሉ፥ የሰው ልጅ ደግሞ በእግዚአብሔር መላእክት ፊት ይመሰክርለታል፤
“I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, him will the Son of Man also confess before the angels of God;
በሰውም ፊት የሚክደኝ በእግዚአብሔር መላእክት ፊት ይካዳል።
but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of the angels of God.
በሰው ልጅም ላይ ቃል የሚናገር ሁሉ ይሰረይለታል፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስን የሚሰድብ ግን አይሰረይለትም።
Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
ወደ ምኵራቦችና ወደ መኳንንቶችም ወደ ገዢዎችም ሲጐትቱአችሁ፥ እንዴት ወይም ምን እንድትመልሱ ወይም እንድትናገሩ አትጨነቁ፤
When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer, or what you will say;
መንፈስ ቅዱስ በዚያች ሰዓት ልትናገሩ የሚገባችሁን ያስተምራችኋልና።
for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”
ከሕዝቡም አንድ ሰው። መምህር ሆይ፥ ርስቱን ከእኔ ጋር እንዲካፈል ለወንድሜ ንገረው አለው።
One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”
1CO 3:9-18: የእግዚአብሔር እርሻ ናችሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ሕንፃ ናችሁ፤ ከእርሱ ጋር አብረን የምንሠራ ነንና።
For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.
የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ እንደ ተሰጠኝ መጠን እንደ ብልሃተኛ የአናጺ አለቃ መሠረትን መሠረትሁ፥ ሌላውም በላዩ ያንጻል። እያንዳንዱ ግን በእርሱ ላይ እንዴት እንዲያንጽ ይጠንቀቅ።
According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.
ከተመሠረተው በቀር ማንም ሌላ መሠረት ሊመሠርት አይችልምና፥ እርሱም ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ነው።
For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.
ማንም ግን በዚህ መሠረት ላይ በወርቅ ቢሆን በብርም በከበረ ድንጋይም በእንጨትም በሣርም ወይም በአገዳ ቢያንጽ፥ የእያንዳንዱ ሥራ ይገለጣል፤
But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or stubble;
በእሳት ስለሚገለጥ ያ ቀን ያሳያልና፥ የእያንዳንዱም ሥራ እንዴት መሆኑን እሳቱ ይፈትነዋል።
each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.
ማንም በእርሱ ላይ ያነጸው ሥራ ቢጸናለት ደመወዙን ይቀበላል፤
If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.
የማንም ሥራ የተቃጠለበት ቢሆን ይጎዳበታል፥ እርሱ ራሱ ግን ይድናል ነገር ግን በእሳት እንደሚድን ይሆናል።
If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.
የእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ እንደ ሆናችሁ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ እንዲኖርባችሁ አታውቁምን?
Don’t you know that you are a temple of God, and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
ማንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ መቅደስ ቢያፈርስ እግዚአብሔር እርሱን ያፈርሰዋል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቤተ መቅደስ ቅዱስ ነውና፥ ያውም እናንተ ናችሁ።
If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.
ማንም ራሱን አያታልል፤ ከእናንተ ማንም በዚች ዓለም ጥበበኛ የሆነ ቢመስለው ጥበበኛ ይሆን ዘንድ ሞኝ ይሁን።
Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he may become wise.

I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
አባቶች ሆይ፥ ከመጀመሪያ የነበረውን አውቃችኋልና እጽፍላችኋለሁ። ጐበዞች ሆይ፥ ብርቱዎች ስለ ሆናችሁ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በእናንተ ስለሚኖር ክፉውንም ስለ አሸነፋችሁ እጽፍላችኋለሁ።

I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
ዓለምን ወይም በዓለም ያሉትን አትውደዱ፤ በዓለም ያለው ሁሉ እርሱም የሥጋ ምኞትና የዓይን አምሮት ስለ ገንዘብም መመካት ከዓለም ስለ ሆነ እንጂ ከአባት ስላልሆነ፥ ማንም ዓለምን ቢወድ የአባት ፍቅር በእርሱ ውስጥ የለም።
Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
ዓለሙም ምኞቱም ያልፋሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ ግን ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
እናንተም ከቅዱሱ ቅባት ተቀብላችኋል፥ ሁሉንም ታውቃላችሁ።
You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.
በተቀጠረ ቀንም ሄሮድስ ልብሰ መንግሥቱን ለብሶ በዙፋን ተቀመጠ እነርሱንም ተናገራቸው፤
On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.
ሕዝቡም። የእግዚአብሔር ድምፅ ነው የሰውም አይደለም ብለው ጮኹ።
The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”
ለእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ስላልሰጠ ያን ጊዜ የጌታ መልአክ መታው በትልም ተበልቶ ሞተ።
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and died.
የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ግን ያድግና ይበዛ ነበር።
But the word of God grew and multiplied.
በርናባስና ሳውልም አገልግሎታቸውን ፈጽመው ከኢየሩሳሌም ተመለሱ፥ ማርቆስ የተባለውን ዮሐንስንም ከእነርሱ ጋር ይዘውት መጡ።
Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.

If a man doesn’t relent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
የሞት መሣርያንም አዘጋጀበት፥ ፍላጻዎቹንም የሚቃጠሉ አደረገ።
He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

It will turn out as a testimony for you.

Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,
ወደረኞቻችሁ ሁሉ ሊቃወሙና ሊከራከሩ የማይችሉትን አፍና ጥበብ እሰጣችኋለሁና።
for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”

እንግዲህ የሻለቃውና ጭፍሮቹ የአይሁድም ሎሌዎች ኢየሱስን ይዘው አሰሩት፥
So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews, seized Jesus and bound him,

But I say this, brothers: the time is short, that from now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;
የሚያለቅሱም እንደማያለቅሱ፥ ደስ የሚላቸውም ደስ እንደማይላቸው፥
and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;
የሚገዙም ምንም እንደሌላቸው፥ በዚችም ዓለም የሚጠቀሙ በሙሉ እንደማይጠቀሙባት ይሁኑ፤ የዚች ዓለም መልክ አላፊ ነውና።
and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.
ነገር ግን ያለ አሳብ ልትኖሩ እወዳለሁ። ያላገባው ጌታን እንዴት ደስ እንዲያሰኘው የጌታን ነገር ያስባል፤

ያገባው ግን ሚስቱን እንዴት ደስ እንዲያሰኛት የዓለምን ነገር ያስባል፥ ልቡም ተከፍሎአል።

This I say for your own profit; not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

“Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
ቀንበሬን በላያችሁ ተሸከሙ ከእኔም ተማሩ፥ እኔ የዋህ በልቤም ትሑት ነኝና፥ ለነፍሳችሁም ዕረፍት ታገኛላችሁ፤

Rejoice in that day, and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

“But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.
እናንተ አሁን የጠገባችሁ ወዮላችሁ፥ ትራባላችሁና። እናንተ አሁን የምትስቁ ወዮላችሁ፥ ታዝናላችሁና ታለቅሱማላችሁ።
Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
ሰዎች ሁሉ መልካም ሲናገሩላችሁ፥ ወዮላችሁ፤ አባቶቻቸው ለሐሰተኞች ነቢያት እንዲሁ ያደርጉላቸው ነበርና።
Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.
ነገር ግን ለእናንተ ለምትሰሙ እላችኋለሁ፥ ጠላቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፥ ለሚጠሉአችሁ መልካም አድርጉ፥
“But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
የሚረግሙአችሁንም መርቁ፥ ስለሚበድሉአችሁም ጸልዩ።
bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
ጕንጭህን ለሚመታህ ደግሞ ሁለተኛውን ስጠው፥ መጐናጸፊያህንም ለሚወስድ እጀ ጠባብህን ደግሞ አትከልክለው።
To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.
ለሚለምንህ ሁሉ ስጥ፥ ገንዘብህንም የሚወስድ እንዲመልስ አትጠይቀው።
Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.
ሰዎችም ሊያደርጉላችሁ እንደምትወዱ እናንተ ደግሞ እንዲሁ አድርጉላቸው።
“As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
የሚወዱአችሁንማ ብትወዱ፥ ምን ምስጋና አላችሁ? ኃጢአተኞች ደግሞ የሚወዱአቸውን ይወዳሉና።

If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.
ነገር ግን ጠላቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፤ መልካም አድርጉ፤ ምንም ተስፋ ሳታደርጉም አበድሩ፥ ዋጋችሁም ታላቅ ይሆናል፥ የልዑልም ልጆች ትሆናላችሁ፥ እርሱ ለማያመሰግኑ ለክፉዎችም ቸር ነውና።
But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.
አባታችሁ ርኅሩኅ እንደ ሆነ ርኅሩኆች ሁኑ።
“Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints:

Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
ጌታችንን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ባለመጥፋት ከሚወዱ ሁሉ ጋር ጸጋ ይሁን፤ አሜን።

We love him, because he first loved us.

If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul, and they begged him,

asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem; plotting to kill him on the way.

He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”
እርስ በርሳቸውም። እንጀራ ስለሌለን ይሆናል ብለው ተነጋገሩ።
They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”
ኢየሱስም አውቆ እንዲህ አላቸው። እንጀራ ስለሌላችሁ ስለ ምን ትነጋገራላችሁ? ገና አልተመለከታችሁምን? አላስተዋላችሁምን?
Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet, neither understand? Is your heart still hardened?
ልባችሁስ ደንዝዞአልን? ዓይን ሳላችሁ አታዩምን? ጆሮስ ሳላችሁ አትሰሙምን? ትዝስ አይላችሁምን?
Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
አምስቱን እንጀራ ለአምስት ሺህ በቈረስሁ ጊዜ፥ ቍርስራሹ የሞላ ስንት መሶብ አነሣችሁ? እነርሱም። አሥራ ሁለት አሉት።
When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”
ሰባቱን እንጀራስ ለአራት ሺህ በቈረስሁ ጊዜ፥ ቍርስራሹ የሞላ ስንት ቅርጫት አነሣችሁ? እነርሱም። ሰባት አሉት።
“When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”
He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”
ወደ ቤተ ሳይዳም መጡ። ዕውርም አመጡለት፥ እንዲዳስሰውም ለመኑት።
He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him, and begged him to touch him.
1TH 1:1-8: ጳውሎስና ስልዋኖስ ጢሞቴዎስም፥ በእግዚአብሔር አብ በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ወደምትሆን ወደ ተሰሎንቄ ሰዎች ቤተ ክርስቲያን፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታ ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ጸጋ ሰላምም ለእናንተ ይሁን።
Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
በጸሎታችን ጊዜ ስለ እናንተ ስናሳስብ፥ የእምነታችሁን ስራ የፍቅራችሁንም ድካም በጌታችንም በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ያለውን የተስፋችሁን መጽናት በአምላካችንና በአባታችን ፊት ሳናቋርጥ እያሰብን፥ እግዚአብሔርን ሁል ጊዜ በሁላችሁ ምክንያት እናመሰግናለን፤
We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
በእግዚአብሔር የምትወደዱ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እንደ ተመረጣችሁ አውቀናልና።
We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,
ወንጌላችን በኃይልና በመንፈስ ቅዱስ በብዙ መረዳትም እንጂ በቃል ብቻ ወደ እናንተ አልመጣምና፤ በእናንተ ዘንድ ስለ እናንተ እንዴት እንደ ነበርን ታውቃላችሁ።
and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.
ደግሞ እናንተ ቃሉን በብዙ መከራ ከመንፈስ ቅዱስ ደስታ ጋር ተቀብላችሁ፥ እኛንና ጌታን የምትመስሉ ሆናችሁ፤
You became imitators of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
ስለዚህም በመቄዶንያና በአካይያ ላሉት ምእመናን ሁሉ ምሳሌ ሆናችሁላቸው።
so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
ከእናንተ ወጥቶ የጌታ ቃል በመቄዶንያና በአካይያ ብቻ አልተሰማምና፥ ነገር ግን ምንም እንድንናገር እስከማያስፈልግ ድረስ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የሚሆን እምነታችሁ በሁሉ ስፍራ ተወርቶአል።
For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out; so that we need not to say anything.
1JN 2:14-20: አባቶች ሆይ፥ ከመጀመሪያ የነበረውን አውቃችኋልና እጽፍላችኋለሁ። ጐበዞች ሆይ፥ ብርቱዎች ስለ ሆናችሁ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በእናንተ ስለሚኖር ክፉውንም ስለ አሸነፋችሁ እጽፍላችኋለሁ።

I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
ዓለምን ወይም በዓለም ያሉትን አትውደዱ፤ በዓለም ያለው ሁሉ እርሱም የሥጋ ምኞትና የዓይን አምሮት ስለ ገንዘብም መመካት ከዓለም ስለ ሆነ እንጂ ከአባት ስላልሆነ፥ ማንም ዓለምን ቢወድ የአባት ፍቅር በእርሱ ውስጥ የለም።
Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
ዓለሙም ምኞቱም ያልፋሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ ግን ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
ልጆች ሆይ፥ መጨረሻው ሰዓት ነው፥ የክርስቶስም ተቃዋሚ ይመጣ ዘንድ እንደ ሰማችሁ አሁን እንኳ ብዙዎች የክርስቶስ ተቃዋሚዎች ተነሥተዋል፤ ስለዚህም መጨረሻው ሰዓት እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለን።
Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
ከእኛ ዘንድ ወጡ፥ ዳሩ ግን ከእኛ ወገን አልነበሩም፤ ከእኛ ወገንስ ቢሆኑ ከእኛ ጋር ጸንተው በኖሩ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ሁሉ ከእኛ ወገን እንዳልሆኑ ይገለጡ ዘንድ ወጡ።
They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
እናንተም ከቅዱሱ ቅባት ተቀብላችኋል፥ ሁሉንም ታውቃላችሁ።
You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
ACT 19:11-17: እግዚአብሔርም በጳውሎስ እጅ የሚያስገርም ተአምራት ያደርግ ነበር፤ ስለዚህም ከአካሉ ጨርቅ ወይም ልብስ ወደ ድውዮች ይወስዱ ነበር፥
God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,
ደዌያቸውም ይለቃቸው ነበር ክፉዎች መናፍስትም ይወጡ ነበር።
so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.
አጋንንትንም እያወጡ ይዞሩ ከነበሩት አይሁድ አንዳንዶች። ጳውሎስ በሚሰብከው በኢየሱስ እናምላችኋለን እያሉ ክፉዎች መናፍስት ባሉባቸው ላይ የጌታን የኢየሱስን ስም ይጠሩባቸው ዘንድ ሞከሩ።
But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”
የካህናትም አለቃ ለሆነ አስቄዋ ለሚሉት ለአንድ አይሁዳዊ ይህን ያደረጉ ሰባት ልጆች ነበሩት።
There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.
ክፉው መንፈስ ግን መልሶ። ኢየሱስንስ አውቀዋለሁ ጳውሎስንም አውቀዋለሁ፤ እናንተሳ እነማን ናችሁ? አላቸው።
The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”
ክፉው መንፈስም ያለበት ሰው ዘለለባቸው ቆስለውም ከዚያ ቤት ዕራቁታቸውን እስኪሸሹ ድረስ በረታባቸው አሸነፋቸውም።
The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
ይህም በኤፌሶን በሚኖሩት ሁሉ በአይሁድና በግሪክ ሰዎች ዘንድ የታወቀ ሆነ፥ በሁላቸውም ላይ ፍርሃት ወደቀባቸው፥ የጌታም የኢየሱስ ስም ተከበረ፤
This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
MAT 24:8-14: እነዚህም ሁሉ የምጥ ጣር መጀመሪያ ናቸው።
But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.
በዚያን ጊዜ ለመከራ አሳልፈው ይሰጡአችኋል ይገድሉአችሁማል፥ ስለ ስሜም በአሕዛብ ሁሉ የተጠላችሁ ትሆናላችሁ።
Then they will deliver you up to oppression, and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.
በዚያን ጊዜም ብዙዎች ይሰናከላሉ እርስ በርሳቸውም አሳልፈው ይሰጣጣሉ እርስ በርሳቸውም ይጣላሉ፤
Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.
ብዙ ሐሰተኞች ነቢያትም ይነሣሉ ብዙዎችንም ያስታሉ፤
Many false prophets will arise, and will lead many astray.
ከዓመፃም ብዛት የተነሣ የብዙ ሰዎች ፍቅር ትቀዘቅዛለች።
Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.
እስከ መጨረሻ የሚጸና ግን እርሱ ይድናል።
But he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.
ለአሕዛብም ሁሉ ምስክር እንዲሆን ይህ የመንግሥት ወንጌል በዓለም ሁሉ ይሰበካል፥ በዚያን ጊዜም መጨረሻው ይመጣል።
This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.
PSA 129:1-m: Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
አቤቱ፥ ድምፄን ስማ፤ ጆሮህ የልመናዬን ቃል የሚያደምጥ ይሁን።
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
MAT 13:47-EOC: ደግሞ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ወደ ባሕር የተጣለች ከሁሉም ዓይነት የሰበሰበች መረብን ትመስላለች፤
“Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet, that was cast into the sea, and gathered some fish of every kind,

ለሚለምንህ ስጥ፥ ከአንተም ይበደር ዘንድ ከሚወደው ፈቀቅ አትበል።
Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
ባልንጀራህን ውደድ ጠላትህንም ጥላ እንደ ተባለ ሰምታችኋል።
“You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’
እኔ ግን እላችኋለሁ፥ በሰማያት ላለ አባታችሁ ልጆች ትሆኑ ዘንድ ጠላቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፥ የሚረግሙአችሁንም መርቁ፥ ለሚጠሉአችሁም መልካም አድርጉ፥ ስለሚያሳድዱአችሁም ጸልዩ፤ እርሱ በክፎዎችና በበጎዎች ላይ ፀሐይን ያወጣልና፥ በጻድቃንና በኃጢአተኞችም ላይ ዝናቡን ያዘንባልና።

የሚወዱአችሁን ብትወዱ ምን ዋጋ አላችሁ? ቀራጮችስ ያንኑ ያደርጉ የለምን?
For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
ወንድሞቻችሁንም ብቻ እጅ ብትነሡ ምን ብልጫ ታደርጋላችሁ? አሕዛብስ ያንኑ ያደርጉ የለምን?
If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
እንግዲህ የሰማዩ አባታችሁ ፍጹም እንደ ሆነ እናንተ ፍጹማን ሁኑ።

PSA 71:1-m: አቤቱ፥ ፍርድህን ለንጉሥ ስጥ፥ ጽድቅህንም ለንጉሥ ልጅ፥
God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

ስለዚህ፥ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ ለመብላት በተሰበሰባችሁ ጊዜ እርስ በርሳችሁ ተጠባበቁ።
Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
ማንም የራበው ቢኖር ለፍርድ እንዳትሰበሰቡ በቤቱ ይብላ። የቀረውንም ነገር በመጣሁ ጊዜ እደነግጋለሁ።
But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.
1JN 2:20-29: እናንተም ከቅዱሱ ቅባት ተቀብላችኋል፥ ሁሉንም ታውቃላችሁ።
You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
እውነትን የምታውቁ ስለ ሆናችሁ፥ ውሸትም ሁሉ ከእውነት እንዳልሆነ ስለምታውቁ እንጂ እውነትን ስለማታውቁ አልጽፍላችሁም።
I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
ክርስቶስ አይደለም ብሎ ኢየሱስን ከሚክድ በቀር ውሸተኛው ማን ነው? አብንና ወልድን የሚክድ ይህ የክርስቶስ ተቃዋሚ ነው።
Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
ወልድን የሚክድ ሁሉ አብ እንኳ የለውም፤ በወልድ የሚታመን አብ ደግሞ አለው።
Whoever denies the Son, the same doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
እናንተስ ከመጀመሪያ የሰማችሁት በእናንተ ጸንቶ ይኑር። ከመጀመሪያ የሰማችሁት በእናንተ ቢኖር፥ እናንተ ደግሞ በወልድና በአብ ትኖራላችሁ።
Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
እርሱም የሰጠን ተስፋ ይህ የዘላለም ሕይወት ነው።
This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
ስለሚያስቱአችሁ ሰዎች ይህን ጽፌላችኋለሁ።
These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
እናንተስ ከእርሱ የተቀበላችሁት ቅባት በእናንተ ይኖራል፥ ማንም ሊያስተምራችሁ አያስፈልጋችሁም፤ ነገር ግን የእርሱ ቅባት ስለ ሁሉ እንደሚያስተምራችሁ፥ እውነተኛም እንደ ሆነ ውሸትም እንዳልሆነ፥ እናንተንም እንዳስተማራችሁ፥ በእርሱ ኑሩ።

As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
አሁንም፥ ልጆች ሆይ፥ በሚገለጥበት ጊዜ እምነት እንዲሆንልን በመምጣቱም በእርሱ ፊት እንዳናፍር በእርሱ ኑሩ።
Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
ጻድቅ እንደ ሆነ ካወቃችሁ ጽድቅን የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ከእርሱ እንደ ተወለደ እወቁ።
If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
ACT 9:10-19: በደማስቆም ሐናንያ የሚሉት አንድ ደቀ መዝሙር ነበረ፥ ጌታም በራእይ። ሐናንያ ሆይ፥ አለው። እርሱም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እነሆኝ አለ።
Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”
ጌታም። ተነሥተህ ቅን ወደ ሚባለው መንገድ ሂድ፥ በይሁዳ ቤትም ሳውል የሚሉትን አንድ የጠርሴስ ሰው ፈልግ፤
The Lord said to him, “Arise, and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,
እነሆ፥ እርሱ ይጸልያልና፤ ሐናንያ የሚሉትም ሰው ገብቶ ደግሞ እንዲያይ እጁን ሲጭንበት አይቶአል አለው።
and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in, and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”
ሐናንያም መልሶ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ በኢየሩሳሌም በቅዱሳንህ ላይ ስንት ክፉ እንዳደረገ ስለዚህ ሰው ከብዙዎች ሰምቼአለሁ፤
But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.
በዚህም ስምህን የሚጠሩትን ሁሉ ለማሰር ከካህናት አለቆች ሥልጣን አለው አለ።
Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”
ጌታም። ይህ በአሕዛብም በነገሥታትም በእስራኤልም ልጆች ፊት ስሜን ይሸከም ዘንድ ለእኔ የተመረጠ ዕቃ ነውና ሂድ፤
But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.
ስለ ስሜ ስንት መከራ ሊቀበል እንዲያስፈልገው እኔ አመለክተዋለሁና አለው።
For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”
ሐናንያም ሄዶ ወደ ቤቱ ገባ፥ እጁንም ጭኖበት። ወንድሜ ሳውል ሆይ፥ ጌታ፥ እርሱም በመጣህበት መንገድ የታየህ ኢየሱስ ነው፥ ደግሞ ታይ ዘንድና መንፈስ ቅዱስ ይሞላብህ ዘንድ ላከኝ አለ።

Ananias departed, and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me, that you may receive your sight, and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
ወዲያውም እንደ ቅርፊት ያለ ከዓይኑ ወደቀ፥ ያን ጊዜም ደግሞ አየ፤ ተነሥቶም ተጠመቀ፥
Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.
መብልም በልቶ በረታ። በደማስቆም ካሉት ደቀ መዛሙርት ጋር ጥቂት ቀን ኖረ።
He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.
PSA 27:7-m: እግዚአብሔር ኃይሌና ጋሻዬ ነው፤ ልቤ በእርሱ ታመነ እኔም ተረዳሁ፤ ሥጋዬም ደስ ይለዋል፥ ፈቅጄም አመሰግነዋለሁ።
Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ኃይላቸው ነው፥ ለቀባውም የመድኃኒቱ መታመኛ ነው።
Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
LUK 16:19-EOC: ቀይ ልብስና ቀጭን የተልባ እግር የለበሰ አንድ ባለ ጠጋ ሰው ነበረ፥ ዕለት ዕለትም እየተመቸው በደስታ ይኖር ነበር።
“Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.
አልዓዛርም የሚባል አንድ ድሀ በቍስል ተወርሶ በደጁ ተኝቶ ነበር፥
A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,
ከባለ ጠጋውም ማዕድ ከሚወድቀው ፍርፋሪ ሊጠግብ ይመኝ ነበር፤ ውሾች እንኳ መጥተው ቍስሎቹን ይልሱ ነበር።
and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.
ድሀውም ሞተ፥ መላእክትም ወደ አብርሃም እቅፍ ወሰዱት፤ ባለ ጠጋው ደግሞ ሞተና ተቀበረ።
The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died, and was buried.
በሲኦልም በሥቃይ ሳለ አሻቅቦ አብርሃምን በሩቅ አየ አልዓዛርንም በእቅፉ።
In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
እርሱም እየጮኸ። አብርሃም አባት ሆይ፥ ማረኝ፥ በዚህ ነበልባል እሣቀያለሁና የጣቱን ጫፍ በውኃ ነክሮ መላሴን እንዲያበርድልኝ አልዓዛርን ስደድልኝ አለ።
He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’
አብርሃም ግን። ልጄ ሆይ፥ አንተ በሕይወትህ ሳለህ መልካም እንደ ተቀበልህ አስብ አልዓዛርም እንዲሁ ክፉ፤ አሁን ግን እርሱ በዚህ ይጽናናል አንተም ትሣቀያለህ።
“But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted, and you are in anguish.
ከዚህም ሁሉ ጋር ከዚህ ወደ እናንተ ሊያልፉ የሚፈልጉ እንዳይችሉ፥ ወዲያ ያሉ ደግሞ ወደ እኛ እንዳይሻገሩ በእኛና በእናንተ መካከል ታላቅ ገደል ተደርጎአል አለ።
Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’
እርሱም። እንኪያስ፥ አባት ሆይ፥ ወደ አባቴ ቤት እንድትሰደው እለምንሃለሁ፤ አምስት ወንድሞች አሉኝና፤
“He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house;
እነርሱ ደግሞ ወደዚህ ሥቃይ ስፍራ እንዳይመጡ ይመስክርላቸው አለ።
for I have five brothers, that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’
አብርሃም ግን። ሙሴና ነቢያት አሉአቸው፤ እነርሱን ይስሙ አለው።
“But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’
እርሱም። አይደለም፥ አብርሃም አባት ሆይ፥ ነገር ግን ከሙታን አንዱ ቢሄድላቸው ንስሐ ይገባሉ አለ።
“He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’
ሙሴንና ነቢያትንም የማይሰሙ ከሆነ፥ ከሙታንም እንኳ አንድ ቢነሣ አያምኑም አለው።
“He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”
PSA 17:11-m: መሰወሪያውን ጨለማ አደረገ፤ በዙሪያውም ድንኳኑ፤ በደመናት ውስጥ የጨለማ ውኃ ነበረ።
He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
በፊቱ ካለው ብርሃን የተነሣ ደመናትና በረዶ የእሳት ፍምም አለፉ።
At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
LUK 12:54-EOC: ደግሞም ሕዝቡን እንዲህ አለ። ደመና ከምዕራብ ሲወጣ ባያችሁ ጊዜ፥ ወዲያው። ዝናብ ይመጣል ትላላችሁ፥ እንዲሁም ይሆናል፤
He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.
በአዜብም ነፋስ ሲነፍስ። ትኩሳት ይሆናል ትላላችሁ፥ ይሆንማል።
When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

PSA 21:9-m: አንተ ግን ከሆድ አውጥተኸኛልና፥ በእናቴ ጡት ሳለሁም በአንተ ታመንሁ።
But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.
ከማኅፀን ጀምሮ በአንተ ላይ ተጣልሁ፤ ከእናቴ ሆድ ጀምረህ አንተ አምላኬ ነህ።
I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
LUK 1:57-m: የኤልሳቤጥም የመውለጃዋ ጊዜ ደረሰ፥ ወንድ ልጅም ወለደች።
Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
ጎረቤቶችዋም ዘመዶችዋም ጌታ ምሕረቱን እንዳገነነላት ሰምተው ከእርስዋ ጋር ደስ አላቸው።
Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy towards her, and they rejoiced with her.
